annotations.title: Termination or layoff letter with HR compliance screen

description: Termination or layoff letter with HR compliance screen — Draft a neutral employment separation letter (involuntary or layoff) and screen it offline: coverage of last day, final pay, benefits/COBRA, company property and HR contact; protected-trait and protected-activity words in the reason (FMLA, pregnancy, complaints, workers comp...) raise legal risk to HIGH; state final-paycheck timing note (CA, CO, MA, NV, MT, HI, CT, DC, OR, UT), WARN Act note for layoffs, OWBPA note when severance is offered. Not legal advice. Params: name (required), lastDay (YYYY-MM-DD), type (involuntary|layoff), reason, company, state (2 letters), severance. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: ai_termination_letter
